newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real currency closes flat in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real currency closes flat in quiet trade.

text.p: Brazil's real closed flat at 1.0810 per dollar in listless trade in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0810 per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market, dealers said.

At 1640 local/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts in the commercial foreign exchange market showed a $160 million surplus. On Friday, the forex contracts posted a $164.2 million surplus.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed unchanged at 1.0865 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.142 per dollar, traders said.
